newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Dec M3 grew at 7.9 pct vs 8 pct in Nov.
newsitem.headline: German Dec M3 grew at 7.9 pct vs 8 pct in Nov.

text.p: The Bundesbank gave the following data for German M3 money supply growth in December.
Annualised vs average Q4 1995 7.9 pct 8.0 pct

Note - The Bundesbank's target range for 1996 M3 money supply growth is four percent to seven percent. For 1997, it has set a range of 3-1/2 to 6-1/2 percent. The Bundesbank also said M3 grew by 8.1 percent in the final quarter of 1996 compared with the fourth quarter 1995.
